name: gitsounds
description: Play a sound you choose whenever a git action succeeds: commit, push, pull, merge and more.

commands.title: Git Sounds: Set Sound for a Git Action

gitsounds.commit.markdownDescription: Sound for **git commit**: `default` (built-in), `off`, or the full path to a .wav/.mp3 file.

gitsounds.push.markdownDescription: Sound for **git push**: `default` (built-in), `off`, or the full path to a .wav/.mp3 file.

gitsounds.pull.markdownDescription: Sound for **git pull**: `default` (built-in), `off`, or the full path to a .wav/.mp3 file.

gitsounds.fetch.markdownDescription: Sound for **git fetch**: `default` (built-in), `off`, or the full path to a .wav/.mp3 file. Off by default because VS Code auto-fetches every few minutes.

gitsounds.merge.markdownDescription: Sound for **git merge**: `default` (built-in), `off`, or the full path to a .wav/.mp3 file.

gitsounds.checkout.markdownDescription: Sound for **git checkout**: `default` (built-in), `off`, or the full path to a .wav/.mp3 file.

gitsounds.rebase.markdownDescription: Sound for **git rebase**: `default` (built-in), `off`, or the full path to a .wav/.mp3 file.

gitsounds.reset.markdownDescription: Sound for **git reset**: `default` (built-in), `off`, or the full path to a .wav/.mp3 file.

gitsounds.stash.markdownDescription: Sound for **git stash**: `default` (built-in), `off`, or the full path to a .wav/.mp3 file.

gitsounds.cherry-pick.markdownDescription: Sound for **git cherry-pick**: `default` (built-in), `off`, or the full path to a .wav/.mp3 file.

gitsounds.revert.markdownDescription: Sound for **git revert**: `default` (built-in), `off`, or the full path to a .wav/.mp3 file.
